statement.zh: Hansen 1970《Artibus Asiae》32(4) 是大都会艺术博物馆 / 纽约大学美术学院 Wolfe 远征在 Tell al-Hiba（拉格什本城）1968–1969 首季的初步报告。
statement.en: Hansen 1970 in Artibus Asiae 32(4) is the preliminary report of the first (1968–1969) season of the Met/NYU Wolfe Expedition at Tell al-Hiba (Lagash city proper).

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
